**Regime: Carry compression risk in a risk-premium (not reward) environment; growth and inflation both soft; policy trapped in major DMs.**

- **AUD/JPY**: AUD deteriorating (growth -0.57, external weak) and stretched (valuation +1.6, carry 89th percentile); JPY improving (+0.6 fundamentals, -1.7 valuation). Classic unwind pair—AUD yield stress (-0.45 real-yield correlation) and crowded carry meet JPY mean reversion.
- **GBP**: Stranded on fragility. Real yields elevated but currency weakens into them (-0.17 corr, risk-premium regime). Carry at 97th percentile, policy trap (feasibility -1.5), inflation mult collapsed (-0.91). Hawkish tailwind has evaporated; vol spike breaks it.
- **CAD**: Cheap on valuation alone (-2.1), other pillars neutral. Decoupled yield regime blurs the play; narrow setup, not structural edge.

**Carry standout:** GBP/USD—highest real yield differential (+1.5% avg) but maximum unwind risk given policy fade, crowding, and risk-premium regime.
